correctness.rationale: For smooth y^5=x^6+u x^3+1 in characteristic 7, gcd(5,6)=1 gives genus 10 and regular differential basis of dimensions 1+2+3+4. Derive the Cartier coefficient formula from y^{7J-j}=f(x)^m and x-exponents congruent 6 mod7; independent SymPy integer multinomial reconstruction finds nine nonzero entries exactly as in the result. The four character blocks have total rank seven whenever u²!=4, so a-number 3. Semilinear four-cycle survivor contraction is Q(u)=(3u²-2)(u^14+2)-4u^8; the other paths die, proving stable rank 4 or 0 without inferring p-rank from one Cartier matrix rank. Independently computed GF7 factorization Q=3(U³+U+1)(U³+U-1)(U⁴-U²+3)(U⁶+3U⁴+2U²+2); its four factors are distinct irreducibles degrees 3,3,4,6; Q is squarefree and coprime u²-4. The arithmetic checks are finite corroboration; the formula/semilinear argument covers every algebraically closed char7 parameter.
